_doc: Physical light (owner 2026-10-07), shared by blender_light.py and ue_light.py so that the Cycles and Unreal takes are lit alike: the sun, the street and vehicle lamps at the web's own levels, the visible dome as the only sky light at sky_k, no fills, untrimmed albedos, and the exposure fixed per time of day (the page's own value for the proof takes until a physical calibration replaces it). The web-matched rig stays behind --light web, for the gate baselines.
